task.objective: 以冒溢为中心，核查前期状态及本次响应。

value.window_policy: one saved neighbor before/after; may require longer investigation

rainfall_timing.interpretation: Earlier rain is temporal context, not proof of residual in-network water.
rainfall_timing.elapsed_from_previous_rain_end_note: Elapsed time can include current rainfall; it is not the zero-rain gap duration. Read the separately bounded dry interval.

antecedent_hydraulics.instruction: Use samples up to event_cutoff for this event; event-local native-resolution series describes its overflow response.

topology_scope.direction_basis: input from_node/to_node; not inferred actual flow or causal direction
limitations: Upstream scope retains only each target incoming link and its endpoint.
Downstream scope retains the first confluence, facility, special node or terminal boundary.
No side branches or extra links at corridor/boundary nodes are automatically included.
A pure downstream split stops with partial coverage; selecting further paths requires supplementation.
Target direct exchanges remain visible when the target itself splits; no branch is followed beyond them.
Intermediate lateral inflows are node processes, not additional direct target sources.
Topology completeness does not establish causal completeness; reversals may need investigation.

structure_audit.direction_basis: input from_node/to_node, not event flow direction

interpretation.findings: Descriptive screening features; hydraulic relevance must be assessed with event processes.
interpretation.grade: End invert drop / input conduit length; solver-adjusted slope is not calculated.
interpretation.alignment: Invert/crown alignment is geometric. Design-water-surface alignment requires discharge and water depth.
interpretation.area: Full-section geometric area including barrels, not a hydraulic capacity ratio.
interpretation.node_levels: Input rim level only when max_depth is explicit; not a universal effective spill threshold.
interpretation.scope: Outside-scope connections are an inventory only; their geometry/processes are not audited.

event_interfaces.window_basis: Provided saved local_process_series, including its context neighbors.
event_interfaces.interpretation: Head above outlet crown establishes outlet submergence only. Neither head ordering nor positive flow alone excludes downstream influence. Flow opposed to the instantaneous head difference requires checking time history, inertia and numerical records; it is not automatically invalid or proof of downstream backwater.

value.share_meaning: direct entering composition, not flood contribution
value.total_inflow_role: comparison only; never added as a source

sampling.anchor_policy: actual samples on both sides of rain/event boundaries, no interpolation

native_metadata.volume_semantics: Native NODE_VOLUME and LINK_VOLUME in m3, not free storage capacity. Toolkit PONDED_VOLUME is the node output slot name; it is not CA2D surface ponding.

interpretation_limits: 前期水力背景按稀疏原生样本提供，不能据此断言两样本之间无短时变化；关键区段可补取原保存分辨率。
同一节点共享历史；分析某事件时只取其起溢及之前的样本，不将后续事件状态倒置为前期证据。
最早保存样本不是模拟初始时刻；结合输入初始设置和可见热启动记录判断，更早历史未提供时保持未知。
节点和管段的体积是各自实际储量，不相加充当独立调蓄容量；有水状态不自动确立M6。
空间范围沿用所选事件的已声明局部结构，不代表整个管网已调查。

evidence_selection.background_scope: Whole-run statistics remain background; do not substitute them for event values.
limitations: Local packages cover only their saved process window; missing values remain unknown.
Initial scope uses one upstream segment and downstream to a retained boundary, without side-branch expansion; it does not guarantee all causes are covered.
Global statistics are not individual-object or causal diagnosis.

model_context.method: all native junction overflow is external to the 1D network; mapping weight=1
model_context.diagnosis_instruction: Both baseline and dynamic_wave use DYNWAVE (dynamic wave routing). Backwater, pressurized flow and hydraulic flow reversal can be represented within the SWMM network; diagnose their occurrence from the actual hydraulic evidence. CA2D coupling remains one-way, with no surface-water feedback or sewer re-entry.
model_context.surface_interpretation: CA2D is synthetic one-way overflow spreading; it is not complete distributed rainfall, infiltration or sewer re-entry.
model_context.map_scale_status: assumed area-informed local scale; not surveyed
model_context.note: Catchment 8 drains directly to outfall 18, bypassing the conduit network, as in the original.
